versions.subject: Detects the creation of a schtask via PowerSploit Default Configuration
ATT&CK tagging of Default PowerSploit Schtasks Persistence
improve(rule): add Empire links and userland match
sysmon rules cleanup and move to process_creation
Update win_powersploit_empire_schtasks.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/Create'
        - '/SC'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'ONLOGON'
        - 'DAILY'
        - 'ONIDLE'
        - 'Updater'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/TN'
        - 'Updater'
        - '/TR'
        - 'powershell'
condition: selection1 and selection2
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\powershell.exe" Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="*/Create*" CommandLine="*/SC*" CommandLine IN ("*ONLOGON*", "*DAILY*", "*ONIDLE*", "*Updater*") CommandLine="*/TN*" CommandLine="*Updater*" CommandLine="*/TR*" CommandLine="*powershell*"
